title: Quality Report
description: Output of the QA (validate/Review) pipeline stage (RFC-0005). Immutable, content-addressed artifact. Extensible metrics groups under the RFC-0005 Schema Evolution Policy: known groups are additive-only; unknown groups and keys are ignored by consumers unless consumed. IMPLEMENTATION DEFERRED past M0 for Scene-level measures (ADR-030); the manifest-level stage and this format are frozen in P1.5.

pipeline_hash.description: Identity of the pipeline run that produced this report (RFC-0003 AC-8).

thresholds.description: Snapshot of the effective quality thresholds (config-derived with documented defaults), grouped like metrics.

metrics.description: Hierarchical metric groups. Known groups (reprojection, coverage, geometry) are typed in the C++ evaluator; additional groups and keys are permitted (Schema Evolution Policy) and ignored by consumers unless consumed.

quality_score.description: Deterministic aggregate 0-100; verdict is its classification.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report generation.
